## ErrorDetailsByCode.RATE_LIMITED property

The caller exceeded its admission limit; the call was not evaluated further and did not run. `retryAfterSeconds` is a non-negative integer: how long to wait before the limit admits another call.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly RATE_LIMITED: {
        readonly retryAfterSeconds: number;
    };
```
